library.name: pipwerks SCORM API Wrapper
library.description: Unmodified upstream pipwerks SCORM wrapper used to bridge gradable iDevices with the LMS SCORM runtime (pipwerks/scorm-api-wrapper@82e455b, byte-identical).

library.name: eXeLearning SCORM 1.2 runtime
library.description: eXeLearning project code, not a third-party library: the SCORM 1.2 runtime the editor assembles into every package it exports (the public/app/common/scorm/scorm12/ layers, built by buildScorm12RuntimeFiles() in https://github.com/exelearning/exelearning), vendored unmodified and installed into every package this plugin extracts. Declared here, like the editor under dist/static in the release ZIP, because it is not under this plugin's licence; the commit it was built from and the digests of both runtime files are pinned in assets/scorm/SOURCE. The version is the runtime stamp in the file header.
